prompt.project_info: Sunny Mediterranean garden lifestyle portrait on a wooden lounge chair.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with light-brown hair and sun-bleached highlights, natural makeup, calm direct gaze and realistic tanned skin, lying prone on a lounge chair and turning her head back; wearing a vibrant red two-piece string bikini and cream/navy baseball cap with a replaceable embroidered front mark.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait from a three-quarter profile, body angled away, supported by arms on a wooden deck chair, extended legs and fruit bowl at lower edge; stone wall, olive trees, dry grass and Mediterranean garden behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct natural sunlight with warm outdoor glow, defined but natural shadows and relaxed sun-drenched vacation mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mobile/social photography, sharp subject, realistic skin and hair texture, natural color, shallow separation from garden background.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic Mediterranean lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long light-brown hair and sun-bleached highlights, lying prone on a wooden lounge chair and looking back over her shoulder, wearing a vibrant red two-piece string bikini and cream baseball cap with navy brim, realistic sunlit skin, olive trees, stone wall, dry grass and a small fruit bowl, bright natural daylight and relaxed vacation mood.
